meta.name: funding
meta.description: Funding round signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about funding signals, Series A/B/C detection, post-raise outreach, budget availability triggers, Crunchbase monitoring, or venture capital signals. Do NOT use for general company events (use company-events skill) or hiring that follows funding (use hiring skill).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现B2B客户融资信号，把握外呼时机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做B2B销售，需要根据客户融资动态调整外呼策略
copy.tagline_en: Discover funding signals for B2B outreach timing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do B2B sales and need to act on customer funding events

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检测目标公司的融资事件，评估信号强弱，建议最佳联系时机（公告后2-4周），并按金额安排24/72小时内行动，同时提供外联话术模板。
howto.when: 当用户询问融资信号、融资轮次检测、融资后外联等话题时触发，也可用于监控 Crunchbase 或风投信号。

say.text: 跟踪这些目标公司的融资轮次。
say.note: 会设置监控并在新融资出现时提醒。

say.text: 某客户刚完成B轮融资，怎么跟进？
say.note: 会给出最佳时机和话术模板。

say.text: 帮我建一个基于融资的外呼流程。
say.note: 会生成包含筛选、评分和分发的流程。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude will detect funding events for target accounts, score the signal, suggest optimal outreach timing (usually 2-4 weeks after announcement), and schedule actions within 24/72 hours based on round size, while providing an outreach template.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions funding signals, funding rounds, post-raise outreach, etc., or asks to monitor Crunchbase or VC signals.

say_en.text: Track funding rounds for these target accounts.
say_en.note: It will set up monitoring and alert on new funding events.

say_en.text: A client just raised a Series B. How should we follow up?
say_en.note: It will suggest optimal timing and a message template.
It will generate a flow with filtering, scoring, and routing.
